title: 第二十五章 巨象吞天 蛮力撼岳 蛮妖盖世一劫第二十六章 千足穿云 万毒噬魂 蜈妖滔天一劫
content_zh:
二十四重劫煞尘埃落定，无尘古寺伪佛烟消，千年炼狱一朝清明。
妖僧伏诛，殿底血海涸尽，地底冤魂尽得超度，盘桓百年的佛门戾气、人心痴障、善恶颠倒之厄尽数消解。方圆百里乡野百姓，挣脱千年愚信枷锁，幡然醒悟，弃盲拜、明善恶、辨真伪、守本心，山野重归淳朴，炊烟复归安宁。
四象真神扫尽此地沉冤黑业，抚慰苍生，抚平地脉，待山川风气全然澄澈，方才辞别万民，振衣西行。
一路渐行渐远，身后梵音香火、良田村落、清秀山林缓缓褪去。
西行百里，天地风貌骤然剧变。
先前一路山明水秀、泉清林茂、风柔气和，尽是俗世福地、温润山川。可越往西天深处走，地气越是沉厚、山势越是雄苍、罡风越是凛冽。
此处无娇柔草木、无婉转流泉、无氤氲瑞气。
放眼望去，尽是太古荒山、亿年危岩、千叠险峰、万重绝壑。
峰峦拔地千丈，绝壁刀削斧劈，山石黝黑粗砺，带着亘古未经雕琢的荒蛮质感。崖壁之上无青苔点缀、无花鸟栖息、无生灵驻足，唯有万古罡风终年穿谷呼啸，穿岩过壑，轰鸣不绝，如太古洪钟长震，震荡八荒。
此地天地气机，不凶、不邪、不毒、不戾，
唯独沉、重、厚、稳四字，压满乾坤。
仿佛整片大地在此沉凝，整条地脉在此蛰伏，万古山川之力尽数盘桓于此，不动则已，一动便可倾山覆岳、震动八荒。
四神一路徐行，皆暗自敛气凝神，心生肃穆。
宁洋北素来执掌青木生机，最善感山川灵气、察地脉变迁。自踏入这片荒莽山地，周身流转的青翠灵息便屡屡滞涩，原本生生不息、游走无碍的生机道韵，被天地间厚重至极的大地之力层层压制、缓缓锁滞。
他抬眸远眺连绵千山，沉声缓道：“此地山川，死气不生、煞气不显、妖气不扬，唯独地力浩瀚无边。
寻常山川，灵气浮动、阴阳流转、动静相生，故而有草木荣枯、鸟兽繁衍、四季更迭。
唯独这片大荒，亿载沉凝、静极不动、地力锁空，生生压得万物不生、万灵不栖、风云不流。
绝非寻常凶地妖域，乃是太古洪荒残留道场。此地蛰伏之物，绝非寻常精怪妖邪。”
王学南止步立岩，垂眸启蓍，推演前路劫机。
蓍草落地，排布沉稳厚重，卦纹如山镇地、如岳擎天，层层沉叠、稳稳扎根，无诡变、无虚浮、无阴煞、无迷乱，是最纯粹的坤地厚重、巨物镇疆、蛮力覆世之象。

他凝神观卦良久，神色愈发端肃，徐徐解卦言道：
“天道七十二难，层层递进、次第有序，先困人心、再乱神识、后破虚妄、终炼体魄。
前二十四难，尽是奸邪惑世、伪善欺心、秽气伤身、幻境迷神之阴柔诡劫，试炼我等道心清明、神识稳固、善恶分辨。
今日卦象已定，第二十五重大劫，正式降临。
此劫无诈、无伪、无毒、无迷，
乃是太古洪荒遗种，镇岳玄象蛮力大劫。
前方两百里，有大荒绝境，名万钧绝壑。
壑阔千里、深不见底、上下亿丈、横贯荒疆，乃是上古天地初分之时，地脉崩裂、乾坤初定遗留的先天沟壑。
壑底沉眠一头太古巨象，自洪荒纪年便扎根此地，不经轮回、不历转生、不靠后天修行。
它天生肉身、天生蛮力、天生地脉道体。
世间万妖，皆有法门、皆有术法、皆有破绽、皆有本源弱点。
或怕纯阳、或惧青木、或畏杀伐、或困幻境、或毒尽则亡、或气竭则灭。
唯独此玄象，万法不习、万术不修、万巧不取、万变不用。
一生道行，只守一字——力。
吸纳亿万年地脉厚重精气，承载整片大荒山岳重压，肉身凝练如先天神铁、洪荒精钢。
皮如万古岩层，刀兵难入；
躯如千峰堆叠，仙法难损；
力如昆仑压顶，万势可破。
它蛰伏万钧绝壑亿载之久，从不主动出壑祸乱苍生，从不吞噬生灵精血，从不争天道气运、从不夺山川灵机。
平日寂然沉眠，与山川同寂、与大地同息、与万古同静。

此番出世阻路，非它作恶，乃是天道定劫，唤它醒世，专试我等肉身根基、正道底气、合力道心。
此劫最是公平，也最是无情。
无诡计可破、无智谋可偷、无弱点可击、无迂回可避、无克制可循。
前二十四难，皆可智取、皆可阵破、皆可术解、皆可心渡。
唯此二十五难，只能以力抗力、以正压蛮、以神躯扛洪荒、以天命破万钧。
content_en:
The dust of the twenty-fourth calamity has settled, the false Buddha in the Wuchen ancient temple has disappeared, and the purgatory for thousands of years has been cleared up.
The monster monk was killed, the sea of ​​blood under the palace dried up, all the innocent souls underground were saved, and the evil spirit of Buddhism that had lingered for hundreds of years, the delusion of people's minds, and the confusion of good and evil were all eliminated. The people in the countryside with a radius of hundreds of miles have broken free from the shackles of thousands of years of foolish faith, awakened, abandoned blind worship, understood good and evil, distinguished truth from falsehood, and kept their true intentions. The mountains and fields have returned to simplicity, and the smoke has returned to peace.
The Four Elephant True Gods swept away the injustice and black karma here, comforted the people, and smoothed the earth. When the mountains and rivers were completely clear, they bid farewell to the people and headed westward.
As we go further and further away, the sound of Sanskrit music, incense, farmland, villages, and beautiful mountains and forests slowly fade away behind us.
Traveling a hundred miles westward, the landscape of heaven and earth suddenly changed dramatically.
Previously, the mountains and rivers were beautiful, the springs were clear, the trees were lush, and the wind was gentle. It was a worldly blessed land and warm mountains and rivers. But the further you go to the west, the thicker the earth becomes, the more majestic the mountains, and the colder the wind.
There are no delicate vegetation, no graceful flowing springs, and no dense auspicious air here.
Looking around, you can see ancient barren mountains, billion-year-old dangerous rocks, thousands of dangerous peaks, and thousands of ravines.
The peaks and ridges are soaring thousands of feet, the cliffs are chopped with knives and axes, and the rocks are dark and rough, with a wild and uncarved texture from ancient times. There are no moss dotted on the cliffs, no flowers and birds perch, and no creatures standing there. Only the eternal wind howls through the valleys, rocks and gullies all the year round, roaring endlessly, like an ancient bell that shakes the entire wilderness.
The qi of heaven and earth here is not evil, evil, poisonous, or violent.
Only the four words "heavy", "heavy", "thick" and "stable" are overwhelming.
It's as if the entire earth is frozen here, the entire earth's veins are dormant here, and all the power of the mountains and rivers of eternity is lingering here. If it doesn't move, it will overturn the mountains and shake the wilderness.
The four gods walked slowly all the way, secretly concentrating their energy and feeling solemn in their hearts.
Ning Yangbei has always been in charge of the vitality of Qingmu, and he is most sensitive to the aura of mountains and rivers and the changes in the earth's veins. Ever since I stepped into this wild mountainous land, the green spiritual energy circulating around my body has been repeatedly stagnant. The vitality that was originally endless and roaming unhindered has been suppressed and slowly locked up layer by layer by the extremely heavy power of the earth between heaven and earth.
He raised his eyes and looked at the thousands of mountains in the distance, and said in a deep voice: "The mountains and rivers here have no life, no evil, no evil, only the vastness of the earth.
In ordinary mountains and rivers, spiritual energy floats, yin and yang circulate, and movement and stillness coexist. Therefore, vegetation flourishes and withers, birds and animals multiply, and the four seasons change.
Only this vast wilderness has been frozen and motionless for hundreds of millions of years, the earth's force is locked in the air, and everything is suppressed, so that no living thing can grow, no soul can live, and no wind and cloud can flow.
It is definitely not an ordinary and dangerous demon realm, but a remnant dojo from ancient times. The things dormant here are definitely not ordinary spirits or monsters. "
Wang Xuenan stopped at Liyan, lowered his eyes, and deduce the hijacking ahead.
The yarrow lands on the ground, the arrangement is steady and thick, the hexagram pattern is like a mountain holding down the ground, like a mountain holding up the sky, stacked layer by layer, firmly rooted, without any strange changes, no vanity, no evil spirits, and no confusion. It is the purest image of the earth being thick, giant objects holding the territory, and brute force overturning the world.
He concentrated on the hexagram for a long time, his expression became more solemn, and he slowly explained the hexagram:
"The seventy-two difficulties of the way of heaven are progressive and orderly. They first trap the human heart, then confuse the spiritual consciousness, then break the illusion, and finally refine the body.
The first twenty-four tribulations are all sinister and deceitful tribulations that confuse the world, hypocrisy deceives the mind, filthy energy harms the body, and illusions confuse the mind. They test our clarity of mind, firmness of spiritual consciousness, and distinction between good and evil.
Today's hexagram has been determined, and the twenty-fifth great tribulation has officially arrived.
This calamity has no deceit, no falsehood, no poison, no delusion;
It is a remnant of the ancient prehistoric times, and the brute force of Zhenyue Xuanxiang caused a great disaster.
Two hundred miles ahead, there is a vast and desperate situation, known as the Wanjun Jue Valley.
The ravine is thousands of miles wide, bottomless, hundreds of millions of feet high and low, and traverses the wilderness. It is an innate ravine left over from the time when the heaven and earth were first divided in ancient times, when the earth's veins collapsed and the universe was first determined.
Sleeping at the bottom of the ravine is an ancient giant elephant, which has taken root here since the dawn of time, without reincarnation, reincarnation, or acquired cultivation.
It is born with a physical body, born with brute force, and born with an earthly body.
All monsters in the world have their own methods and techniques., all have flaws, all have inherent weaknesses.
Some are afraid of pure yang, some are afraid of green wood, some are afraid of killing, some are trapped in an illusion, some may die if the poison is exhausted, or some may die if the energy is exhausted.
Only in this mysterious phenomenon, all methods cannot be practiced, all techniques cannot be cultivated, all tricks cannot be used, and all changes cannot be used.
Throughout your life, you should only stick to one word - strength.
It absorbs the thick essence of hundreds of millions of years of earth veins, carries the weight of the entire wilderness mountain, and the physical body is condensed like innate divine iron and prehistoric fine steel.
The skin is like an eternal rock formation, difficult for weapons to penetrate;
The body is like a thousand peaks stacked on top of each other, and the immortal magic is hard to damage;
The force is like Kunlun pressing the top, and all forces can be broken.
It has been dormant for hundreds of millions of years, never taking the initiative to cause harm to the people, never devouring the essence and blood of living beings, never competing for the destiny of heaven, and never taking away the inspiration of mountains and rivers.
I sleep in silence on weekdays, as silent as the mountains and rivers, as silent as the earth, as silent as the eternity.
This time of rebirth is blocking the way, not because it has done evil, but because of the calamity decreed by heaven, calling it to wake up and specifically test our physical foundation, righteous path confidence, and combined force Dao heart.
This calamity is the most fair and the most ruthless.
There are no tricks to defeat, no cunning to steal, no weaknesses to attack, no detours to avoid, no restraint to follow.
The first twenty-four difficulties can all be overcome wisely, broken through formations, solved with skill, and overcome with the heart.
Only for these twenty-five difficulties, we can only resist force with force, suppress the barbarians with positive force, withstand the great wilderness with the body of a god, and defeat all odds with destiny.
